scenario: LUNI.11.2 — the `:u` format spec (the unit label) requires the path to be unit-typed. `{r.raw:u}` where `raw: Float` is a plain Float slot rejects with DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_UNIT_NON_UNIT, in `dsc.validate.luni_11_2_format`.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    raw: Float key

rule bad:
    Reading r
->
    log info "unit is {r.raw:u}"
